title: Cohere
description: Cohere links players together so their XP, effects, and custom abilities synchronize and strengthen whenever they team up.
body:
![Cohere - Connect your players, share your power. features include sharing xp, potion effects, attributes. All of those are toggleble through the config. All messages of this plugin are also configurable using minimessage. More features in the future. How to install?
